close_reason: Review complete: 2 correctness issues confirmed (1 fixed, 1 existing pattern), 3 API design fixes (Id→String, Display impls, Mdn constructor), 2 elegance fixes (CRLF chain, let-else)
notes:
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: C2 (state race) — this is a general JMAP server problem not unique to MDN, depends on whether the dispatcher serializes requests per-account. C1 (Id vs String for creation IDs) — depends on whether Id has any normalization. Uncertainty driven by: not reading the full jmap-types Id implementation to verify Id::from(&str) is a pure newtype. Would raise confidence if: read Id::from impl to confirm no normalization, and read dispatcher docs to confirm whether per-account serialization exists.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — The handler logic is sound and the spec validation is correct. Two public API type errors (Id for creation IDs, missing Display) need fixing before v0.1. The CRLF chain is ugly but correct. The JSON round-trip pattern for #[non_exhaustive] Mdn is forced by design and documented.
